title: M1: Define artifact.state.v1, feedback.event.v1, artifact.patch.v1 schemas
body: Lock the initial schema contracts. Acceptance: schemas exist, examples validate, docs explain versioning and compatibility.

title: M1: Implement core patch application and version checks
body: Implement JSON Patch subset: add, replace, remove, test. Reject artifact_id mismatch and base_version mismatch. Acceptance: unit tests and image-feedback fixture pass.

title: M1: Implement event log replay for artifact patches
body: Replay initial state plus JSONL events and produce final state. Acceptance: CLI replay supports examples/image-feedback/events.jsonl.

title: M1: Build ImageAnnotator point/box feedback component
body: Implement normalized coordinate mapping for pointer box selection and emit agent.feedback.v1 events. Acceptance: component emits box_comment with x/y in [0,1].

title: M1: Build React ArtifactRenderer
body: Render ArtifactState views to trusted React components. Acceptance: ImageFeedbackPanel, DecisionPanel, TextFeedbackBox supported; unknown views render diagnostic fallback.

title: M1: Build playground image-feedback loop
body: Show state, rendered artifact, feedback event, mock agent patch, updated state, and event log in one UI.

title: M1: Add CLI commands validate, apply-patch, replay
body: Provide local developer commands to validate JSON, apply patches, and replay event logs.

title: M1: Add GitHub Actions CI
body: CI should run install, schema validation, typecheck, tests, and package builds.

title: M2: Add host sandbox and postMessage bridge hardening
body: Harden origin checks, event schema validation, sandbox policy, and CSP helpers. Acceptance: security tests reject unknown action and invalid origin.

title: M2: Add capability manifest and component catalog negotiation
body: Host should expose supported protocols/components/actions/budget. Agent-kit should compose manifest into patch prompts.

title: M2: Add action registry and confirmation boundary
body: Define action metadata: side_effect, requires_confirmation, required_permission. Unknown actions rejected by default.

title: M2: Add runtime lockfile and migration registry
body: Store runtime/protocol/catalog versions with artifacts. Add migration hooks and tests.

title: M3: Add gateway service skeleton
body: Implement REST endpoints for artifacts, feedback, events, patches, and assets. Add in-memory store first.

title: M3: Add asset store abstraction
body: Represent images/audio/files as asset references. Avoid embedding large binary payloads in model context.

title: M3: Add replay regression test suite
body: Run historical fixtures through replay on every CI build and detect state drift.

title: M4: Add Web Component renderer
body: Expose <agent-artifact> custom element for cross-framework embedding.

title: M4: Add static HTML export adapter
body: Export trusted artifact state to static HTML for reports. Keep this separate from production runtime path.

title: M4: Add A2UI/MCP adapter exploration
body: Explore mapping ArtifactState to A2UI and action registry to MCP tools/resources. Keep optional and non-blocking.
